collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: The Heathens set aside a day of their own to honor their dead.

description_variants.description: The Isolans set aside a day of their own to honor their dead.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: The Heathens set aside a day of their own to honor their dead. No work is done at the encampment. People sit by the mud hut, walk by the stream, and tell each other the old names. (subject) is the one who lights the first fire of the evening, and for once even the noisiest children are quiet.
